I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-random: the ticket is #8841.

Tobias posted it in that channel yesterday (Oct 13) at 09:27. He said West yard Door 2 at Marrow Fieldworks is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841. Pree is in that channel, so the answer comes from something she could already see.

Tobias has owned the Marrow Fieldworks account since January, so I told her to check with him if she needs the ticket's current status before the call. I couldn't find a ticket file for the account to confirm the status myself.
